svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner: landing page, the plan drawn as an exploded parts-catalogue figure
svg.text: Import the Locations, Inventory and Transactions files. Every
part is classified by its picks, pick groups are found, and you
mark the best locations. Recommendations come in rounds, each
with its rule and its numbers. You apply, adjust or keep in place;
The demo runs on synthetic data, data as of 2026-09-30.
Rules you can check by hand. No AI at runtime, no account needed.
Parts table, Fig. 1: how a plan is built
Steps in the order you take them
A frozen import with its data-as-of date. Errors name the file, the row and the column.
Movement classes from picks (24+, 6–23, 1–5, 0) and pick groups at 5+ shared jobs.
Whole aisles, levels or single locations. The tool never guesses which are best.
Rule 1, 2 and 3 each name the numbers behind them. Apply, apply elsewhere, or keep in place.
Per aisle: parts in and out, fast-moving in best locations, pick groups together.
Round order, from-location before to-location, a tick box per line. Legible in black and white.
